title: U.S. Senate passes bipartisan budget resolution to fund government
text: WASHINGTON (Reuters) - The United States Senate approved a bipartisan compromise budget bill early Friday morning, averting an imminent federal shutdown. Leaders from both parties praised the negotiations as essential for defense and social security stability.

title: Federal Reserve holds benchmark interest rate steady amid moderating inflation
text: WASHINGTON (Reuters) - The Federal Open Market Committee announced it will maintain the federal funds rate between 5.25 and 5.50 percent, citing consistent progress toward the 2 percent annual inflation objective and strong employment statistics across major industries.

title: NASA James Webb Space Telescope confirms water vapor and carbon dioxide on exoplanet
text: BALTIMORE (Reuters) - Astronomers analyzing observational spectroscopic data from the James Webb Space Telescope verified the definitive presence of water vapor, methane, and carbon dioxide in the upper atmosphere of habitable zone exoplanet K2-18b, located 120 light years away.

title: European Union approves landmark artificial intelligence regulation framework
text: BRUSSELS (Reuters) - Lawmakers in the European Parliament formally ratified the Artificial Intelligence Act on Wednesday, establishing the world first comprehensive legal rules for generative and autonomous computer models in healthcare, law, and education.

title: Global central banks coordinate liquidity facilities to stabilize currency markets
text: LONDON (Reuters) - The Bank of England, European Central Bank, and Bank of Japan executed planned swap operations today to ensure continuous dollar liquidity for commercial lending institutions during quarterly fiscal closures.

title: Pharmaceutical research consortium publishes Phase 3 clinical trial for novel oncology therapy
text: BOSTON (Reuters) - Clinical oncologists reported significant increases in progression-free survival rates among patients participating in double-blind international Phase 3 evaluation trials for targeted cellular immunotherapies published in the New England Journal of Medicine.

title: Supreme Court delivers unanimous ruling on interstate commercial trade disputes
text: WASHINGTON (Reuters) - The Supreme Court issued a 9-0 opinion clarifying state jurisdiction over interstate digital commerce and taxation, ruling that federal regulatory statutes take precedence over individual municipal tariffs.

title: Department of Transportation announces infrastructure funding for rail and highway repairs
text: CHICAGO (Reuters) - Transportation officials finalized an 8.5 billion dollar allocation intended for bridge rehabilitation and high-speed rail corridor expansions spanning Midwest freight hubs, aiming to modernize supply chain logistics.

title: World Health Organization reports substantial decrease in global seasonal influenza transmission
text: GENEVA (Reuters) - Surveillance laboratories collaborating across 110 countries documented lower hospital admissions for respiratory infections, reflecting widespread immunization coverage and improved clinical response protocols.

title: Treasury Department releases quarterly financial audit confirming stable national reserves
text: WASHINGTON (Reuters) - An official statement released by the Treasury Department confirmed that statutory borrowing operations and revenue collections aligned with legislative projections, providing sufficient reserve buffers for debt service obligations.
